name: Chlornaltrexamine
summary: β-Chlornaltrexamine (β-CNA) is a non-selective irreversible antagonist of the μ-opioid receptor (MOR), the δ-opioid receptor (DOR), and the κ-opioid receptor (KOR), which forms a covalent bond to the binding sites of these receptors and has ultra-long-lasting opioid antagonist effects.

pharmacology.text: β-Chlornaltrexamine (β-CNA) is a non-selective irreversible antagonist of the μ-opioid receptor (MOR), the δ-opioid receptor (DOR), and the κ-opioid receptor (KOR), which forms a covalent bond to the binding sites of these receptors and has ultra-long-lasting opioid antagonist effects.

uses.en: It is a laboratory research tool, used to permanently switch off opioid receptors so scientists can study how they work and how quickly the body replaces them.
uses.zh: 它是實驗室研究工具，用來永久關閉鴉片類受體，讓科學家研究這些受體如何運作，以及身體多快能補充新的受體。
uses.zhHans: 它是实验室研究工具，用来永久关闭鸦片类受体，让科学家研究这些受体如何运作，以及身体多快能补充新的受体。

fact.en: It carries a nitrogen mustard group, the same reactive chemistry found in early cancer drugs, which lets it weld itself permanently to opioid receptors.
fact.zh: 它帶有氮芥基團，與早期抗癌藥物中的反應性化學結構相同，讓它能永久地「焊」在鴉片類受體上。
fact.zhHans: 它带有氮芥基团，与早期抗癌药物中的反应性化学结构相同，让它能永久地「焊」在鸦片类受体上。
